name: Charm
effect: Control effect. Prevents the target from using skills and forces them to attack the caster's current target. Cannot be inflicted with Taunt while Charmed.

name: Debilitate
effect: Cannot take action.

name: Deep Freeze
effect: Special Status. Cannot be dispelled. Ignores control immunity. Target is incapacitated: cannot move, attack, or cast skills. Damage Immunity decreased by 100%. Lasts 8s.

name: Disarm
effect: Cannot launch basic attacks.

name: Entangle
effect: Unable to move.

name: Freeze
effect: Control effect. Cannot take action. Unable to move, attack, or cast skills.

name: Frost
effect: Can stack. Freezes the target for 7 seconds upon reaching 9 stacks.

name: Icebound
effect: Cannot take action. Unable to move, attack, or cast skills.

name: Imprisonment
effect: Unable to move.

name: Knockback
effect: Interrupts the target's current action and knocks them back.

name: Petrify
effect: Control effect. Cannot take action. Unable to move, attack, or cast skills.

name: Seal
effect: Special Status: If a Sealed skill is an active skill, it cannot be cast. If it is a passive skill, it will not take effect (will not affect passive effects that have already been triggered).
remark: The Seal effect is ineffective against bosses.

name: Silence
effect: Cannot cast active skills.

name: Sleep
effect: Unable to move, attack, or cast skills. The Sleep status is removed when taking damage.

name: Spider Cocoon
effect: Cannot take action.
remark: This effect lasts for 5 seconds.

name: Stun
effect: Control effect. Unable to move, attack, or cast skills.

name: Taunt
effect: Control effect. Forces the target to attack themselves and prevents them from using active skills.

name: Time Stasis
effect: Control effect. Cannot take action. Unable to move, attack, or cast skills.

name: Adaptive Damage
effect: Deals physical or magic damage according to the caster's attack type.

name: Bleed
effect: Deals a single instance of physical damage equal to 10% of Attack x the number of stacks on the target. Lasts 10 seconds.

name: Judgment
effect: Deals additional magic damage to the target equal to 100% of Attack.

name: Parasitic Seed
effect: Every 2 seconds, deals magic damage equal to 10% of the target's Max HP.

name: Power Strike
effect: Fires a laser at the Arcane Phoenix.
remark:
Reduces the Arcane Phoenix's Energy by 1.
Deals damage equal to 0.4% of the Arcane Phoenix's Max HP.

name: Twin Heaven Sigil
effect: Special status. Lasts for 8s and cannot stack. When Rin is on the battlefield, when allies with [Deathrattle] deal damage to targets afflicted with [Twin Heaven Sigil], they deal additional damage equal to the damage source's [Deathrattle] stacks multiplied by 9% of their Attack. If the damage is dealt by Rin or a [Sword Clone], the additional damage is increased to [Deathrattle] stacks multiplied by 36% of Attack.

name: Venom Fang
effect: When Venom Mark reaches 4 stacks, it detonates, immediately dealing physical damage and removing all stacks.

name: Withering Thorn
effect: Special Status. The target takes physical damage equal to 800% of their Attack every 2 seconds (up to a maximum of 1,600% of the applier's own Attack). Lasts for 8s. Only 1 target on the field can be in the [Withering Thorn] status at a time.

name: Darkmoon
effect: Special Status. Untargetable during its duration. Cannot be stacked. Cannot be dispelled.

name: Divine Melody
effect: Buff effect. Grants immunity to [Healing Down] and [Heal Block], and increases Damage Reduction based on current HP percentage. Lasts for 6s.

name: Lightning Aegis
effect: Increases Damage Immunity by 30%. When taking damage, has a 25% chance to deal magic damage equal to 4% of the attacker's current HP. Lasts 6 seconds. Cannot stack.

name: Rooted
effect: Lasts until the end of the battle. Upon receiving healing, gains a shield equal to 3% of Max HP for 6 seconds.

name: Sanctuary
effect: Buff Status: During its duration, cannot be inflicted with Stat Debuffs or Elemental Debuffs. Lasts for 6s.

name: Shield
effect: Blocks a certain amount of damage.

name: Super Armor
effect: Immune to control effects.

name: Unyielding
effect: Cannot fall below 1 HP.

name: Basic Elemental Debuff
effect: Includes [Ignite], [Chill], and [Shock].

name: Chill
effect: Basic elemental debuff. Reduces healing effects by 15%. Lasts 10 seconds.
remark:
Triggers [Evaporation] when the target is afflicted with [Ignite].
Triggers [Flash Freeze] when the target is afflicted with [Shock].

[Evaporation] Instantly deals magic damage equal to 10% of the target's Max HP.
Damage cannot exceed 300% of Attack.
Additionally reduces Hit by 1,500.
This effect lasts for 8 seconds.

[Flash Freeze] Instantly deals magic damage equal to 10% of the target's Max HP.
Damage cannot exceed 300% of Attack.
Additionally reduces Attack Speed by 150%.
This effect lasts for 8 seconds.

name: Detonation
effect: [Elemental Echo] faction special effect.
remark:
[Ignite] and [Shock] can trigger [Detonation].
Upon triggering, instantly deals magic damage equal to 30% of the target's Max HP.
Damage cannot exceed 900% of Attack.

name: Elemental Debuff
effect: Advanced Elemental Debuffs: [Evaporation] and [Flash Freeze].
remark: Basic Elemental Debuffs: [Ignite], [Chill], and [Shock].

name: Elemental Reaction
effect: [Elemental Echo] faction special effect.
remark:
Includes [Detonation], [Evaporation], and [Flash Freeze].
[Ignite] and [Shock] can trigger [Detonation].
[Chill] and [Ignite] can trigger [Evaporation].
[Shock] and [Chill] can trigger [Flash Freeze].

[Detonation] Instantly deals magic damage equal to 30% of the target's Max HP.
Damage cannot exceed 900% of Attack.

[Evaporation] Instantly deals magic damage equal to 10% of the target's Max HP.
Damage cannot exceed 300% of Attack.
Additionally reduces Hit by 1,500.
This effect lasts for 8 seconds.

[Flash Freeze] Instantly deals magic damage equal to 10% of the target's Max HP.
Damage cannot exceed 300% of Attack.
Additionally reduces Attack Speed by 150%.
This effect lasts for 8 seconds.

name: Evaporation
effect: Advanced elemental debuff. Reduces Hit by 1,500. Lasts 8 seconds.
remark:
[Chill] and [Ignite] can trigger [Evaporation].
Upon triggering, instantly deals magic damage equal to 10% of the target's Max HP.
Damage cannot exceed 300% of Attack.

name: Flash Freeze
effect: Advanced elemental debuff. Reduces Attack Speed by 150%. Lasts 8 seconds.
remark:
[Shock] and [Chill] can trigger [Flash Freeze].
Upon triggering, instantly deals magic damage equal to 10% of the target's Max HP.
Damage cannot exceed 300% of Attack.

name: Ignite
effect: Elemental debuff. Deals magic damage equal to 3% of the target's Max HP every 2 seconds. Lasts 10 seconds.
remark:
Each instance of damage cannot exceed 100% of Attack.
Triggers [Detonation] when the target is afflicted with [Shock].
Triggers [Evaporation] when the target is afflicted with [Chill].

[Detonation] Instantly deals magic damage equal to 30% of the target's Max HP.
Damage cannot exceed 900% of Attack.

[Evaporation] Instantly deals magic damage equal to 10% of the target's Max HP.
Damage cannot exceed 300% of Attack.
Additionally reduces Hit by 1,500.
This effect lasts for 8 seconds.

name: Shock
effect: Elemental debuff. Reduces Crit Resist by 200. Lasts 10 seconds.
remark:
Triggers [Detonation] when the target is afflicted with [Ignite].
Triggers [Flash Freeze] when the target is afflicted with [Chill].

[Detonation] Instantly deals magic damage equal to 30% of the target's Max HP.
Damage cannot exceed 900% of Attack.

[Flash Freeze] Instantly deals magic damage equal to 10% of the target's Max HP.
Damage cannot exceed 300% of Attack.
Additionally reduces Attack Speed by 150%.
This effect lasts for 8 seconds.

name: Azure Form
effect: Additionally increases Attack by 20%. Slightly supercharges Overdrives and Ultimates.

name: Battle Form
effect: Additionally increases Attack by 70%. Significantly supercharges Overdrives and Ultimates.

name: Bloodferno Form
effect: Bloodthirster Sword - Tyrfing's exclusive status. Lasts until the end of the battle.

name: Fire Aspect
effect: In this form, the Titanborn wields the [Ignite] effect.
remark:
Inflicting [Chill] can instantly trigger [Evaporation].
Inflicting [Shock] can instantly trigger [Flash Freeze].

name: Ice Aspect
effect: In this form, the Titanborn wields the [Chill] effect.
remark:
Inflicting [Ignite] can instantly trigger [Evaporation].
Inflicting [Shock] can instantly trigger [Flash Freeze].

name: Thunder Aspect
effect: In this form, the Titanborn wields the [Shock] effect.
remark:
Inflicting [Ignite] can instantly trigger [Detonation].
Inflicting [Chill] can instantly trigger [Flash Freeze].

name: Violet Blade Form
effect: Additionally increases Attack by 40%. Moderately supercharges Overdrives and Ultimates.

name: War God Form
effect: Additionally increases Attack by 100%. Massively supercharges Overdrives and Ultimates.

name: Clarity
effect: Restores 20 Mana per second. Lasts 8 seconds.

name: Holy Healing
effect: Dispels 1 debuff from the target and restores HP to the target and allies within a medium circular area around them.

name: Mercy
effect: Restores HP equal to 100% of Attack to the allied Luminary or Wyrm with the lowest HP percentage.

name: Attack Boost
effect: Stat Buff status. Increases Attack by 30%. Lasts for 8s.
remark: Does not stack with [Significant Attack Boost].

name: Attack Speed Up
effect: Stat buff status. Increases Attack Speed by 45%. Lasts for 8s. Does not stack with [Significant Attack Speed Boost].

name: Attack Stat Buff
effect: Includes Attack Up, Bonus Damage Up, Attack Speed Up, Crit Up, Crit Damage Up, and Hit Up.

name: Balance
effect: Buff effect. Increases Damage Reduction.
remark:
Can stack up to 3 times.
Decreases by 1 stack every 6 seconds.

name: Berserk
effect: Increases Attack Speed and Movement Speed by 50%. Lasts 8 seconds.

name: Bonus Damage Up
effect: Stat buff effect. Increases Bonus Damage by 30%. Lasts 8 seconds.

name: Crit Damage Up
effect: Stat buff effect. Increases Crit Damage by 45%. Lasts 8 seconds.

name: Crit Up
effect: Stat buff effect. Increases Crit by 600. Lasts 8 seconds.

name: Damage Reduction Up
effect: Stat buff effect. Increases Damage Reduction by 30%. Lasts 8 seconds.

name: Defense Stat Buff
effect: Includes Damage Reduction Up, Physical Defense Up, Magic Defense Up, and Dodge Up.

name: Descending Judgment
effect: Increases Physical Defense and Magic Defense by 25%. Lasts 10 seconds.

name: Divinity
effect: Each time this status is gained, the bearer powers up, increasing Bonus Damage and Damage Reduction by 6%. Stacks up to 4 times. This effect ends with the corresponding domain.

name: Dodge Up
effect: Buff effect. Increases Dodge by 600. Lasts 8 seconds.

name: Dragon Roar
effect: Increases Attack, Physical Defense, and Magic Defense by 5% (this effect is enhanced via Wyrmspell Dragon Roar upgrading).

name: Eagle Eye
effect: Increases Hit by 250. Lasts 5 seconds.

name: Excitement
effect: Buff effect. Increases Attack by 20%. Lasts 8 seconds.
remark: Increases Attack by an additional 20% while in the [Wild] status.

name: Fervor
effect: Blessing effect. Increases Physical Defense, Magic Defense, and Bonus Damage by 15%. Lasts 8 seconds.
remark: This effect is doubled while in the [Grace] status.

name: Flame Armor
effect: Buff effect. Increases Physical Defense by 30%. Lasts until the end of the battle.

name: Healing Up
effect: Buff effect. Increases healing received by 50%. Lasts 8 seconds.

name: Health Up
effect: Buff effect. Increases HP by 30%. Lasts 8 seconds.

name: Hit Up
effect: Buff effect. Increases Hit by 600. Lasts 8 seconds.

name: Lifesteal
effect: Buff effect. Increases Lifesteal by 30%. Lasts 8 seconds.

name: Limit Breaker
effect: Increases Bonus Damage and Lifesteal by 30%. Lasts 10 seconds.

name: Magic Defense Up
effect: Stat buff effect. Increases Magic Defense by 35%. Lasts 8 seconds.

name: Morale
effect: Blessing effect. Increases Attack and Damage Reduction by 15%. Lasts 8 seconds.
remark: This effect is doubled while in the [Grace] status.

name: Nirvana
effect: Significantly increases damage. Supercharges all skills.

name: Physical Defense Up
effect: Stat buff effect. Increases Physical Defense by 35%. Lasts 8 seconds.

name: Plunder
effect: Buff effect. Increases Physical Defense by 50%. Lasts until the end of battle.

name: Reflect Up
effect: Buff effect. Increases Reflect by 30%. Lasts 8 seconds.

name: Shroud
effect: Increases HP. Upon defeat, inflicts the attacker with Demoralized.

name: Significant Attack Boost
effect: Advanced Stat Buff status. Increases Attack by 45%. Lasts for 8s.
remark: Does not stack with [Attack Boost].

name: Significant Attack Speed Boost
effect: Advanced stat buff status. Increases Attack Speed by 70%. Lasts for 8s.
remark: Does not stack with [Attack Speed Boost].

name: Significant Dodge Boost
effect: Buff effect. Increases Dodge by 900. Lasts 8s. Does not stack with [Dodge Up].

name: Significant Physical Defense Boost
effect: Advanced stat buff status. Increases Physical Defense by 55%. Lasts for 8s.
remark: Does not stack with [Physical Defense Up].

name: Stat Buff
effect: Includes Attack Up, Bonus Damage Up, Damage Reduction Up, Physical Defense Up, Magic Defense Up, Attack Speed Up, Crit Up, and Crit Damage Up.

name: Zephyr
effect: Increases Attack Speed by 5%. Lasts 5 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times.

name: Attack Down
effect: Stat debuff effect. Reduces Attack by 30%. Lasts 8 seconds.

name: Attack Speed Down
effect: Stat debuff effect. Reduces Attack Speed by 45%. Lasts 8 seconds.

name: Attack Stat Debuff
effect: Includes Attack Down, Bonus Damage Down, Attack Speed Down, Crit Down, Crit Damage Down, and Hit Down.

name: Binding
effect: Debuff effect. Reduces the target's current Attack Speed by 50%. Lasts 8 seconds. Cannot stack.

name: Blind
effect: Reduces Hit by 250. Lasts 8 seconds.

name: Bonus Damage Down
effect: Stat debuff effect. Reduces Bonus Damage by 30%. Lasts 8 seconds.

name: Commander's Intimidation
effect: Special Status. Cannot be dispelled. Reduces damage dealt by the target to self by 8%. Stacks up to 5 times. Lasts for 8s.

name: Crit Damage Down
effect: Stat debuff effect. Reduces Crit Damage by 45%. Lasts 8 seconds.

name: Crit Down
effect: Stat debuff effect. Reduces Crit by 600. Lasts 8 seconds.

name: Curse of Malice
effect: Each stack reduces healing received by 5%.
remark: Can stack up to 9 times.

name: Damage Reduction Down
effect: Stat debuff effect. Reduces Damage Reduction by 30%. Lasts 8 seconds.

name: Defense Stat Debuff
effect: Includes Damage Reduction Down, Physical Defense Down, Magic Defense Down, and Dodge Down.

name: Demoralized
effect: Reduces Attack by 25%. Lasts 8 seconds. Cannot stack. (Can counter Rally.)

name: Discipline
effect: If the target doesn't unleash an Overdrive while this effect is active, their Overdrive Energy cost increases by 1 when the effect ends. This effect lasts for 6 seconds.

name: Disease
effect: Reduces healing received by 40%. Lasts 8 seconds.

name: Dodge Down
effect: Debuff effect. Reduces Dodge by 600. Lasts 8 seconds.

name: Drunken Step Aroma
effect: Debuff effect. Reduces target's Skill Haste by 10 per stack, up to 8 stacks. Lasts 8s.

name: Expose
effect: Each stack of Exposure increases damage taken from Van Helsing by 10%. Lasts 20 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times.

name: Heal Block
effect: Debuff effect. Reduces healing received by 100%. Lasts 8 seconds.
remark: Doesn't stack with [Healing Down].

name: Healing Down
effect: Debuff effect. Reduces healing received by 50%. Lasts 8 seconds.
remark: Doesn't stack with [Heal Block].

name: Hit Down
effect: Debuff effect. Reduces Hit by 600. Lasts 8 seconds.

name: HP Down
effect: Debuff effect. Reduces HP by 30%. Lasts 8 seconds.

name: Luck
effect: Reduces Crit by 750%. Lasts 8 seconds. Cannot stack.

name: Magic Defense Down
effect: Stat debuff effect. Reduces Magic Defense by 35%. Lasts 8 seconds.

name: Physical Defense Down
effect: Stat debuff effect. Reduces Physical Defense by 35%. Lasts 8 seconds.

name: Pulsefield
effect: Reduces Crit Resist by 25. Lasts 5 seconds.

name: Reflect Down
effect: Debuff effect. Reduces Reflect by 30%. Lasts 8 seconds.

name: Rend
effect: Reduces Damage Reduction by 15%. Lasts 8 seconds.

name: Scar
effect: Debuff effect. Reduces healing received by 20%. Lasts until the end of the battle.

name: Scorching Sun
effect: Special status. Cannot be dispelled. Reduces Magic Defense by 9% per stack. Stacks up to 6 times. Lasts for 10s.

name: Sigil of Radiance
effect: Special status. Cannot be dispelled. Reduces Crit Resistance by 75 per stack. Stacks up to 10 times. Lasts for 15s.

name: Significant Magic Defense Down
effect: Advanced Stat Debuff status. Reduces Magic Defense by 55%. Lasts 8 seconds. Does not stack with [Magic Defense Down].

name: Significant Physical Defense Down
effect: Advanced Stat Debuff status. Reduces Physical Defense by 55%. Lasts 8 seconds. Does not stack with [Physical Defense Down].

name: Slow
effect: Reduces Attack Speed and Movement Speed by 20%. Lasts 5 seconds. Cannot stack.

name: Spider Eggs
effect: Reduces the Physical Defense of surrounding units by 3%.
remark:
[Spider Eggs] can be purged by holy light.
Reduces Physical Defense by up to 10%.

name: Spider Venom
effect: Each stack reduces the target's Damage Reduction by 20%. This effect is permanent and cannot be dispellable. Effects granted by different units can stack.
remark: On obtaining Blessing buffs, clears [Spider Venom].

name: Stat Debuff
effect: Includes Attack Down, Bonus Damage Down, Damage Reduction Down, Physical Defense Down, Magic Defense Down, Attack Speed Down, Crit Down, and Crit Damage Down.

name: Copy
effect: The copied summon will have the same stats, duration, and buff/debuff status as the original summon, with full HP. If a non-self summon is copied, it is counted separately from the original summon when calculating the quantity limit.

name: Mech Sphere
effect: A maximum of 6 Mech Spheres can exist on the field at once, regardless of activation. Inactive Mech Spheres remain for up to 20s. Mech Spheres are automatically destroyed when their activation ends.

name: Mummy
effect: A maximum of 4 can exist on the battlefield at the same time.

name: Summon
effect: Special elite summon. Cannot be duplicated.

name: Awakening
effect: Special [Arcane Wisdom] faction status. Lasts until the end of the battle.
remark:
Gained when any ally Luminary unleashes an Overdrive.
Can stack up to 9 times.

name: Deathrattle
effect: Special [Otherworld Return] faction status. Lasts until the end of the battle.
remark:
Each time this status is gained, it restores 2% of Max HP.
Can stack up to 30 times.

name: Dragonblood Burst
effect: Jester's unique status effect. Increases Bonus Damage by 50%. Lasts 3 seconds. Cannot stack.

name: Dragonkin
effect: Jester's unique status effect. Can transform into a Dragonkin, gaining new skills.

name: Featherfall
effect: Panis's special effect. Heals the ally hero with the lowest HP and dispels any debuffs from them.

name: Grace
effect: Special [Sanctum Glory] faction status. Lasts until the end of the battle.
remark: When in this status, [Morale] and [Fervor] effects are doubled.

name: Intimidate
effect: Warborn Goddess's special mark. No special effects. Lasts 5 seconds. Stacks up to 8 times.

name: Punishment
effect: [Illusion Veil] faction special effect.
remark: Automatically triggers when a skill that can activate Punishment targets a Luminary with an Overdrive Energy cost of at least 4.

name: Radiant Ember
effect: Exclusive status of Warborn Goddess - Brynhild. Lasts until the end of battle. Stacks up to 3 times.

name: Wild
effect: Special [Wild Spirit] faction status.
remark:
This status continuously consumes Rage.
This status ends when Rage is depleted.

name: Wyrmshade
effect: Excella's unique status effect. Supercharges her for the duration.

name: Actual Damage Value
effect: The actual damage value is the difference in HP before and after being attacked.

name: Archon's Authority
effect: Special status. Lasts for 30 seconds. Can stack up to 6 times.

name: Banish
effect: Special Status: When Banished, cannot be targeted, passive skills cannot trigger, and all skill cooldowns and buff durations are frozen. Cannot be Banished when only 1 Luminary remains on the battlefield.

name: Black Dragon's Claw
effect: Special status. Lasts for 6s. Can stack up to 5 times.

name: Blade Shade
effect: Buff Status: Lasts for 6s. Can stack up to 20 times.

name: Blessing Buff
effect: Includes [Morale] and [Fervor].

name: Corresponding Color
effect: [Ignite] corresponds to [Red], [Chill] corresponds to [Blue], and [Shock] corresponds to [Yellow].

name: Curse
effect: Debuff. Cannot be stacked. Cannot be dispelled.

name: Demon Hunter
effect: Upon reaching 5 stacks, clears all stacks and inflicts Silence for 6 seconds.

name: Energy Recovery Subclass
effect: Energy Recovery Subclasses include: Servant, Friar, High Priest

name: Energy Reduction Subclass
effect: Energy Reduction Subclasses include: Believer, Fanatic, Executor

name: Equalize
effect: Sets the target's HP percentage to the team's current average HP percentage. Unaffected by healing effects.

name: Frost Vortex
effect: [Frost Vortex] Consumes 1 stack of [Ice Soul Mark] per second. When [Ice Soul Mark] stacks reach 0, [Frost Vortex] ends immediately. If no enemy phantoms exist within [Frost Vortex], it ends prematurely.

name: Full Moon
effect: Buff Status: Lasts for 6 seconds. Cannot be stacked and cannot be dispelled.

name: Holy Light
effect: Calls down holy light centered on the Luminary.
remark: Instantly purges [Spider Eggs] in a small area.

name: Life Link
effect: Units in the Life Link Status share all damage they receive.

name: Link
effect: Special status. Lasts until the end of the battle.

name: Momentum Burst
effect: Special Status. Cannot be Dispelled.

name: Moon Soul
effect: Buff Status: Lasts for 6 seconds. Can stack up to 5 times.

name: Nether Sight
effect: Special status. Lasts until the end of battle. Stacks up to 20 times.
